blocks.text:
For children, the trip brings a series of different adventures. In Rio, you can ride the cable car, travel through Tijuca Forest, visit Maracanã Stadium, the Botanical Garden or the royal city of Petrópolis. At Iguazu, you can approach the waterfalls by speedboat and see colourful tropical birds. In Búzios, several free days give you time for the sea, beaches and family relaxation.

## Why this route works well for families with children

Your first 4 nights are in Rio, so you do not have to change hotels every day after your international flight. Next come 2 nights at Iguazu with nature activities, followed by 5 nights in Búzios for time at the beach. Sightseeing days alternate with free time. In Rio, you can choose additional activities, from a walk in the Botanical Garden to a visit to Maracanã Stadium, Petrópolis, a boat trip or a helicopter flight.
